post.description: Export a read-only simulation report from an authorized project revision. Include the revision and draft state, check-set fingerprint, seed, and complete EvidenceRef audit trail. This operation does not commit project changes or bypass human confirmation.

Stage a physics patch with a nonempty EvidenceRef list for each changed engineering input, keyed by JSON Pointer relative to physics. Each supplied field replaces the matching draft field. Requires the active writer lease, epoch and matching revisions. Apply via the existing fingerprint-bound human review and commit flow.

Validate the MIC JSON and its part reference. Atomically stage the MIC attachment, its SHA-256 and EvidenceRef citations, and set physics.micMatrixRef to the attachment ID. Requires the active writer lease, epoch and matching revisions. Apply via the existing fingerprint-bound human review and commit flow.

Analyze the leased draft using explicit Monte Carlo settings. Use the same samples for the rigid and compliant calculations. Optional What-If inputs affect the trial only. Results are advisory and do not approve or commit any revision.

Stage datums upserts with EvidenceRef citations. Requires the authorized active writer and matching epoch and revisions. Use the existing fingerprint-bound human review and commit flow to apply the draft.

Stage gdt upserts with EvidenceRef citations. Requires the authorized active writer and matching epoch and revisions. Use the existing fingerprint-bound human review and commit flow to apply the draft.
Run the deterministic GD&T solver for the leased draft. What-if edits are temporary and the result is advisory. Use fingerprint-bound human review to approve staged changes.

MicMatrixPayloadV1.description: The runtime parser must reject non-finite numbers and enforce one matrix row per measurement point and one column per control point.

GdtFeatureControlEdit.description: Datum modifier count must not exceed the datum count. Upper size deviation must be at least the lower deviation. Composite lower tolerance cannot exceed the upper tolerance. Lower datums must be an ordered prefix, and lower modifiers require corresponding datums. Cylindricity requires a cylindrical feature. Runout requires an axis datum and resolves MMC/LMC to RFS with warnings.
